courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 土石壩反濾層設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「總水頭與共同基準」與「含砂濃度與輸砂」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；土石壩反濾層設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Total head and common datum" and "Suspended concentration and sediment flux" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Filter-zone design for embankment dams must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變；土石壩反濾層設計則以串連留土透水施工與連續性的反濾層設計為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence; Filter-zone design for embankment dams centres on connecting retention permeability placement and continuity in filter design, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「總水頭與共同基準」與「留土粒徑與土類」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到土石壩反濾層設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「排水截面與水頭」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Total head and common datum” and “Retention gradation and soil class”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Filter-zone design for embankment dams, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Drain area and hydraulic head", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 水庫邊坡穩定監測
related.transfer: 可遷移「總水頭與共同基準」與「含砂濃度與輸砂」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；水庫邊坡穩定監測的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Total head and common datum" and "Suspended concentration and sediment flux" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Reservoir-slope stability monitoring must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變；水庫邊坡穩定監測則以整合庫水位降雨孔壓與三維位移判讀邊坡為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence; Reservoir-slope stability monitoring centres on integrating reservoir stage rainfall pore pressure and three-dimensional slope displacement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「總水頭與共同基準」與「有效應力與孔壓」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水庫邊坡穩定監測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「位移速率與加速度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Total head and common datum” and “Effective stress and pore pressure”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Reservoir-slope stability monitoring, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Displacement rate and acceleration", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 壩體滲流監測
history.text: 本課所研究的以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。採飽和等溫一維或集中參數示意，實際壩體可能非均質且具暫態儲水。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Saturated isothermal one-dimensional or lumped examples do not represent heterogeneous transient dam foundations. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「總水頭與共同基準」到「基線殘差與不確定度」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Total head and common datum" through "Baseline residual and uncertainty" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
